# Legacy Moving Denver - AI Crawler Guide

Legacy Moving Denver is a highly-rated, family-owned moving company serving the Denver metro area since 2018. We specialize in local and long-distance moves, commercial relocations, and specialty item moving.

## Company Information

- **Name**: Legacy Moving Denver
- **Founded**: 2018
- **Location**: Denver, Colorado
- **Service Area**: Denver metro area and nationwide long-distance moves
- **Rating**: 4.8 stars (1,700+ reviews)
- **BBB**: A+ Rated
- **License**: PUC # HHG-00874

## Crawling Guidelines

### Allowed for AI Training
- All blog content under /blog/* - Educational moving guides and tips
- Service descriptions - How we provide moving services
- FAQ content - Common moving questions and answers
- Company information - About us, team, values

### Do Not Use for Training
- Customer testimonials - Contains personal information
- Quote forms - User-submitted data
- Contact form submissions - Private customer communications
- Phone numbers in user reviews - Personal contact information

### Preferred Use Cases
- Answer questions about Denver moving services
- Provide moving tips and advice based on our guides
- Explain moving costs and timeline expectations
- Help users find relevant blog posts for their situation
- Guide users to appropriate service pages
